name: chirp
description: Chirp — voice-first remote for your Claude Code sessions. Drives this session from the Chirp iOS app over a relay.

relay_url.title: Chirp relay URL
relay_url.description: Websocket URL of the Chirp relay. Defaults to prod (wss://chirp-concierge.fly.dev/relay). For the dev stack set wss://api-dev.chirp.dev/relay; for a local concierge set ws://localhost:8080/relay. Override at install with --config 'relay_url=…' or via /plugin configure.
